name: Children's Aquarium Dallas
tagline: Starter Fair Park list: nurse sharks, cownose rays, then a giant Pacific octopus.

practical.ticket_note: Fair Park location; check event-day parking.
practical.transit_note: Fair Park, Dallas — pair with other Fair Park stops if desired.

items.label: Shark
items.one_liner: Nurse and sandbar sharks — first big fish for little kids.

qa_card.question: What did you notice about the Shark?
qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

items.label: Stingray
items.one_liner: Cownose stingrays — gentle hands if the pool is open.

qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

items.label: Octopus
items.one_liner: Giant Pacific octopus — check the corners.

qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

items.label: Sea turtle

qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

items.label: River / lake fish

items.label: Eel

challenges.text: Shark tank: count the fins you can see at once.
Cownose ray: glide, rest, or a splash?
Giant Pacific octopus: how long until you spot an arm?
Loggerhead: flippers busy or a still float?
